items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: spec-generation.md folds Quality Requirements into the FR table with FR ids, drops the QR- id space, keeps Constraints as a prose-only section with no C- ids, and adds no Category column (per operator decision 2026-08-14). Existing spec.md (with its historical QR-01) is left untouched, as instructed.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Docs + test-only change; no runtime error-handling paths touched.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input, secrets, or auth surfaces touched.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: test_spec_generation_qr_fold.py asserts on outcomes (parsed FrTableRow objects from the shared fr_table_reader, and literal absence of retired id patterns), not internal state. Covers both a happy path (quality-target rows parse as ordinary FR rows) and a regression guard (the retired QR-/C- id shapes no longer appear as live examples).

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New test file follows existing plugins/shipwright-project/tests/ conventions (module-level docstring, plain functions, no new abstractions). 114 LOC, well under the 300-line budget.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized-format producer or consumer changed. The FR table SHAPE (FR_TABLE_HEADER, shared/scripts/lib/fr_table_shape.py) is unchanged -- confirmed by re-running integration-tests/test_fr_table_shape_convergence.py (13 passed) after the edit. This change only retires an id space that nothing ever consumed.
